svg.text: Every gate below the stage runs on every pull request. A rule that skips one cannot reach a published bundle.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bundles are additive: they extend Pipelock's built-in scanners and never override them.
